mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy environment supports risk asset performance.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 7.0%, it signals a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 12-month moving averages indicates robust economic activity across manufacturing and construction sectors, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST exceed their 12-month averages, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.1% in 3 months), the increased cost of capital reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% in 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high level of retail sales (RSAFS) above $400 billion indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS exceeds $400 billion, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 900 thousand units, it signals robust residential construction activity that boosts related sectors and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 900, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.5%), the weak labor market suppresses consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 12-month averages indicates strong consumer demand across multiple sectors, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST exceed their 12-month averages, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
